title: The Listening Chamber
text: A round chamber of smooth black stone opens before you, its floor polished like a drum skin. Every whisper here carries for miles, down through cracks into the dark. Something deep below is listening for footsteps. Once, faintly, it taps back.

options.label: Everyone creeps across, soft as breath, praying the floor stays silent.

outcomes.text: Nothing hears you, though every heartbeat sounds like a drum on the way across.
Something hears. It comes up through the cracks.

options.label: Shout a challenge down into the dark to show it you are not afraid.

outcomes.text: It comes up, and it is not afraid either.

options.label: The sharpest ear listens back, to learn what waits below.

outcomes.text: They hear where it sleeps, where it eats and where it keeps its things.
